claims.text: The proposed model combines a gating mechanism with tensor products to improve learning of long-term dependencies in sequential data.
By integrating the tensor product operation, the model enhances the representation of hidden layers, allowing for more powerful interactions between input layers.
The model utilizes stochastic gradient optimization methods to optimize parameters based on gradients derived from input and hidden layers.
